DP.board.deleteBody: Delete {count} pin(s)? The documents behind them are not touched.
DP.board.emptyHint: Alt-drag a journal from the sidebar onto the map, or:
DP.board.help: ↑↓ move · {alt}↑↓ reorder · Space reveal · N reveal next · {shift}Space spotlight · Enter configure · L find · O open · {shift}S show · F flash · M shape · / search · Esc clear · {shift}click range · {ctrl}click add · {shift}chip solo
DP.board.mismatchHint: Some players can see a pin they cannot open.
DP.board.noPins: Nothing is pinned to this scene yet.
DP.board.revealAllBody: Reveal {count} hidden pins on this scene, each to the players it remembers? They appear on those players' screens at once, and a reveal cannot be unseen.
DP.board.revealAllFailed: Reveal all did not go through. Some pins may still be hidden.
DP.board.revealAllHint: Reveal all: every hidden pin on this scene, each to its own audience
DP.board.revealNextHint: N — to the players it remembers, then on to the one after it
DP.board.title: Pinboard
DP.card.missing: The document this pin points at no longer exists.
DP.card.packLocked: This document is in a compendium you cannot open.
DP.card.pdf: This page is a PDF; open it to read it.
DP.chat.noMatch: No journal, page, actor or item in the world or its compendiums matches "{query}".
DP.cheat.chipSolo: Show it to that player alone
DP.cheat.chipToggle: Show it to that player, or hide it
DP.cheat.clear: Clear the search, then the selection
DP.cheat.dismiss: Close the palette, then let go of the pin
DP.cheat.fit: Fit the height to the content
DP.cheat.freePlace: Hold to place off the grid
DP.cheat.reorder: Move the row — its order is the reveal order
DP.cheat.show: Show the document to its audience
DP.chip.actions: Click toggles. Shift-click shows it to {name} only.
DP.chip.opensButCannotSee: {name} can open the document but cannot see the pin.
DP.chip.seesButCannotOpen: {name} can see the pin but cannot open the document.
DP.chip.summaryMismatch: Visible to {seeing} of {total} players — {mismatched} cannot open it
DP.chip.visible: {name} can see this pin and open the document.
DP.config.adoptNoteBody: Replace this map note with a pinned document? The note will be removed; the journal it points at is untouched.
DP.config.adoptNoteHint: Places a Documents Pinner pin where this note stands, then removes the note. The journal itself is never touched.
DP.config.isPin: Treat this tile as a pinned document
DP.config.unpinBody: The tile stays on the scene, but its pin settings are discarded and any ownership it granted is released.
DP.config.unpinTitle: Stop treating this tile as a pin?
DP.ghost.placedHidden: Pinned "{name}" — hidden until you reveal it.
DP.hud.flash: Flash (everyone who can see the map)
DP.hud.spotlight: Reveal & spotlight (pulls every player's view here)
DP.hud.spotlightNarrow: Reveal & spotlight (views stay put: it is not for everyone)
DP.hud.title: Pin controls
DP.keys.cancelHint: Only acts while a pin is being placed; otherwise Escape behaves normally.
DP.keys.cycleAudience: Cycle who can see the selected pins
DP.keys.cycleAudienceHint: Steps through everyone, the remembered selection, and hidden.
DP.keys.fitSelected: Fit the selected props to their content
DP.keys.fitSelectedHint: Sets each one's height so the whole document shows at its current width and text size.
DP.keys.openPinboardHint: Every pin on the scene, with visibility, effects and bulk actions.
DP.keys.peekHint: Hold to fade every prop so the map underneath can be read.
DP.keys.pinLastUsedHint: Arms placement with the document and effect you used last, so a run of markers costs no dialogs.
DP.keys.revealNextHint: The first hidden pin in the Pinboard's order — within its filter while it is open — shown to the players it remembers. Unbound until you give it a key.
DP.keys.toggleMode: Switch the selected pins between icon and prop
DP.keys.toggleModeHint: The same anchor either way, so nothing that refers to the pin breaks.
DP.migration.done: Updated {count} pin(s) to the current format.
DP.migration.prompt: {pinCount} pin(s) on {sceneCount} scene(s) you have not opened were made with an earlier version. Update them now? They already work either way; this only rewrites them into the current format.
DP.migration.reanchored: Re-anchored {count} prop(s): the selection frame and the resize grip now sit on the paper. Nothing moved on the map.
DP.migration.title: Documents Pinner — update pins
DP.module.title: Documents Pinner
DP.notice.cannotOpenYet: You can see this pin, but the GM has not granted access to the document yet.
DP.notice.degraded: Pins were costing too much per frame, so every one was lowered a detail level.
DP.notice.editHoldFailed: The pin could not be hidden, so it is still showing while you edit.
DP.notice.editHoldResumeFailed: The pin you hid while editing could not be revealed again. It is still hidden: reveal it from the HUD or the Pinboard.
DP.notice.editHoldsResumed: Revealed again: {count} pin(s) you had hidden while editing when the page closed.
DP.notice.embeddedRefused: An item an actor owns, or a token's own actor, cannot be pinned. Pin the actor or the item from the sidebar instead.
DP.notice.fitUnavailable: Could not measure this document's content, so its height was left alone.
DP.notice.flashHidden: Hidden pins are not flashed: a ping would show every player where it is.
DP.notice.grantsNarrowed: {count} pin(s) were sharing a whole journal to show one page. Each now shares only its own page.
DP.notice.importFailed: “{name}” could not be imported from its compendium, so nothing was pinned.
DP.notice.imported: “{name}” was imported into the “{folder}” folder. The pin shows this copy, which you can share with your players like anything else in your world.
DP.notice.ledgerRepaired: Repaired {count} leftover permission grant(s) from pins that no longer exist.
DP.notice.noteNoSource: That note does not point at a journal, so there is nothing to pin.
DP.notice.noteNotSaved: Create the note first, then convert it — this one does not exist yet.
DP.notice.ownershipOverridden: Permissions for "{ownershipKey}" were changed by hand; Documents Pinner left them alone.
DP.notice.ownershipWriteFailed: Could not update document permissions. The pin is visible, but players may not be able to open it.
DP.notice.packLocked: This pin's document is in a compendium your GM has not opened to you, so it cannot be shown here.
DP.notice.packUnreadable: Some of your players cannot open the compendium “{pack}”: they see a placeholder instead of this document. To share it with them, choose it in Pin a document — Import & pin makes a world copy they can be given.
DP.notice.peekTip: Tip: hold {key} to fade the documents lying on the map and read what is underneath.
DP.notice.placeFailed: The pin could not be placed. Placement is still active; click again to retry.
DP.notice.retargetSyncOff: This pin now shows an actor, so revealing it no longer grants access: the poster reads in place without it. To list the actor in your players' sidebar, at Limited, switch access on in Pin Studio's Audience tab.
DP.notice.revealNextFailed: The next pin could not be revealed.
DP.notice.revealNextNone: Nothing on this scene is hidden: there is nothing left to reveal.
DP.notice.revealNextNoneInView: Nothing is hidden in the Pinboard's current view. Clear its filter or search to reach the rest.
DP.notice.revealedNoAccess: Revealed. It opens the document's sheet, which will refuse until you grant access.
DP.notice.selectFirst: Select a pin first — click one on the Notes layer, or focus a row in the Pinboard.
DP.notice.showJournalsOnly: Show to players opens journals only. An actor's or an item's pin is shown by revealing it, and reads in place on the map.
DP.notice.showNobody: Nobody in this pin's audience can see it yet, so there is no one to show it to.
DP.notice.showUnavailable: This Foundry build has no Journal.show, so the document could not be pushed to players.
DP.notice.sourceMissing: The document behind this pin no longer exists.
DP.notice.spotlightElsewhere: This pin is on a scene you are not viewing, so nothing was pointed at. View its scene to spotlight it.
DP.notice.spotlightFailed: The pin could not be revealed, so nothing was spotlit.
DP.notice.spotlightNarrow: Nobody's view was moved: this pin is not for everyone, and a pull reaches every player — it would show the rest of the table where it lies.
DP.onboarding.boardLine: P opens the Pinboard: every pin on the scene, who can see it, one-click reveals.
DP.onboarding.dragLine: Alt-drag a journal from the sidebar onto the map. A ghost follows the cursor; click to place.
DP.onboarding.findLater: Both tools are in the Notes scene controls whenever you want them: Pin a document, and the Pinboard.
DP.onboarding.grabLine: Click a pin on the Notes layer to grab it; drag its corners to show more or less of the page.
DP.onboarding.lastLine: Shift+P places the last document again, with no dialogs.
DP.onboarding.title: Documents Pinner
DP.onboarding.welcome: Pin a journal, page, image or PDF onto the map, as a small icon or as a readable prop lying on the scene.
DP.picker.hint: Compendiums are searched from two letters. Enter takes the highlighted row.
DP.picker.lockedHint: Some of your players cannot open this compendium. Choosing it imports a copy into the world, which you can share with them.
DP.picker.more: {count} more in compendiums — keep typing to narrow them down.
DP.picker.search: Search journals, actors, items and compendiums
DP.picker.title: Pin a document
DP.pin.error.missingSource: This pin has no source document or image, so it shows a placeholder.
DP.pin.warn.badEnum: {path} does not accept "{value}"; the default was used.
DP.pin.warn.badField: {path} is not a text field this module can read ({value}); the automatic choice was used.
DP.pin.warn.badFont: {path} is not a typeface this module can use ({value}); the effect's was used.
DP.pin.warn.badPath: {path} is not a usable file path ({value}); it was cleared.
DP.pin.warn.badSound: {path} is not a sound on this server ({value}); nothing was changed. A sound is a file in your world or in Foundry's own data, never a web address.
DP.pin.warn.droppedParams: Dropped {count} effect override(s) this version does not understand.
DP.pin.warn.futureVersion: This pin was made with a newer version (v{found}, this is v{supported}). Unsupported settings were dropped.
DP.preset.error.badId: "{value}" is not a valid preset id. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
DP.preset.error.coreReadOnly: Shipped presets cannot be changed. Duplicate it first.
DP.preset.warn.badColour: {path} is not a valid colour ({value}); the default was used.
DP.preset.warn.badEnum: {path} does not accept "{value}"; the default was used.
DP.preset.warn.badFont: {path} is not a typeface this module can use ({value}); the card's own was used.
DP.preset.warn.badSound: {path} is not a sound on this server ({value}); the preset stays silent. A sound is a file in your world or in Foundry's own data, never a web address.
DP.preset.warn.futureVersion: This preset was made with a newer version (v{found}, this is v{supported}). Unsupported settings were dropped.
DP.presets.deleteBody: Delete this preset? Pins using it fall back to no effect.
DP.presets.menuHint: Create and tune your own effect presets, and import ones other people have shared.
DP.presets.name: Name
DP.presets.readOnly: Shipped preset — duplicate it to edit
DP.presets.readOnlyHint: This preset ships with the module. Duplicate it to make changes.
DP.presets.revealSoundHint: Played for each player as the prop appears on their screen, at their Environment volume. A file on your own server, never a web address: a shared preset must not reach outside it.
DP.presets.sample: The Duke's seal is broken. Whatever was inside is already spent.
DP.presets.title: Preset Studio
DP.reader.title: Pinned document
DP.settings.autoDegrade.hint: If pins start costing more than a few milliseconds per frame, lower every detail level by one and say so once.
DP.settings.autoDegrade.name: Reduce detail automatically
DP.settings.defaultAudience.hint: Whether a pin is visible the moment you place it, or waits until you reveal it.
DP.settings.defaultAudience.name: Default visibility
DP.settings.defaultMode.hint: What a newly placed document becomes before you change it.
DP.settings.defaultMode.name: Default shape
DP.settings.defaultMode.pin: Icon — small, like a map note
DP.settings.defaultOwnershipSync.hint: Revealing a pin also lets its players open the document, so it appears in their sidebar and stays there afterwards. With this off, players see the content without any permission being changed.
DP.settings.defaultOwnershipSync.name: Grant document access on reveal
DP.settings.dropModifier.hint: Hold this while dragging a journal or an item onto the map to place a pin. Without it, dragging does what Foundry always does. Actors are pinned this way only with Ctrl or Shift: Alt-dragging an actor is Foundry's own way to place a hidden token, and is left alone.
DP.settings.dropModifier.name: Drag-to-pin modifier
DP.settings.effectsLevel.hint: Automatic follows your reduced-motion setting, your hardware and the frame rate. Reduced keeps each effect's look and drops only its animation.
DP.settings.effectsLevel.name: Effect level
DP.settings.logLevel.hint: How much this module reports to the browser console. Debug names every texture it draws, evicts or fails on, and is what a useful bug report needs.
DP.settings.logLevel.name: Console detail
DP.settings.placementLegend.hint: Display the keys for rotating, scaling and switching shape beside the preview while you place a pin.
DP.settings.placementLegend.name: Show placement controls
DP.settings.rendering.canvas: Into the scene where the browser allows (PDF pages)
DP.settings.rendering.hint: A journal prop is always drawn as an overlay over the map — not lit, fogged or occluded, because browsers refuse to draw HTML into a scene. A PDF page can be drawn into the scene, where it is lit, fogged and occluded like the map. "Always as an overlay" draws everything the cheap way.
DP.settings.rendering.name: Prop rendering
DP.settings.vramBudgetMb.hint: How much video memory props may hold between them. Past it, the props you have not looked at longest drop to a low-detail version.
DP.settings.vramBudgetMb.name: Texture memory budget (MB)
DP.studio.fadeUnderTokensHint: So a prop lying across a corridor never hides what is standing on it.
DP.studio.fogNote: Visible through fog — reveal it when they reach it.
DP.studio.followNameHint: Renaming the document renames the pin.
DP.studio.fontHint: A generic face reads the same in every world. A named one is this world's own — Foundry's, or one added in Font Config.
DP.studio.grantsActor: Lists “{name}” in their sidebar at Limited, never more: Observer would open its whole sheet. What a Limited sheet shows is your game system's choice.
DP.studio.grantsItem: Lists the item “{name}” in their sidebar and opens its sheet to them. What its sheet shows is your game system's choice.
DP.studio.grantsJournal: Shares the whole journal “{entry}”, every page in it.
DP.studio.grantsJournalHint: Choose a page on the Content tab to share only that one.
DP.studio.grantsPack: From the compendium “{pack}”: revealing it shows “{entry}” to the players whose role can open that compendium. Its access is set per role for the whole pack, so nothing is granted and nothing is added to their sidebars.
DP.studio.grantsPage: Shares the page “{page}” only. Its journal, “{entry}”, is listed in their sidebar as Limited.
DP.studio.holdBanner: Hidden while you edit — players see nothing until you reveal it again
DP.studio.holdHint: Hidden from the table now, and revealed again to the same players when you close this window
DP.studio.iconHint: What this pin shows on the map while it is a small icon — and, for a prop, while its page is being drawn.
DP.studio.label: Label
DP.studio.labelHint: Leave empty to follow the source document's name.
DP.studio.liveBanner: Visible to {count} player(s) — changes are live
DP.studio.marginHint: In multiples of the text size, so they follow it.
DP.studio.pageHint: Which page of the journal lies on the map. Opening the pin lands on the same page.
DP.studio.pageIsOne: This pin was placed on a single page, so there is no other page to choose.
DP.studio.pdfAppearance: This pin shows a PDF page, painted straight into the scene — so it is lit and occluded like the map itself. Effects apply to it, baked into the page: the tint, the grain, the grid, the corner marks and a still band of light. The paper stock, the typeface, the text size, the margins and anything that moves do not, because it has no card and a texture cannot animate.
DP.studio.pdfPageHint: Which page of the PDF lies on the map. One at a time; pin it again for another.
DP.studio.retargetBody: This pin will show {name} instead. Anyone who can see it sees the new document at once, and the access it granted to the old one is released.
DP.studio.retargetHint: Point this pin at something else. Its size, effect and audience stay.
DP.studio.revealSoundBrowse: Choose a sound for this prop…
DP.studio.revealSoundHint: Plays for each player as this prop appears on their screen, at their Environment volume. Your own screen never sees it arrive — ▶ is how you hear it.
DP.studio.revealSoundIcon: Only a prop has a reveal: shown as an icon, this pin appears without one.
DP.studio.showTitle: Show the title on the card
DP.studio.syncHint: Also puts the document in their sidebar and leaves it there.
DP.studio.syncLevelActorHint: An actor is shared at Limited at most: Observer would open its whole sheet, stats included. What a Limited sheet shows is your game system's choice.
DP.studio.syncLevelHint: Limited shows the document exists without opening it. Owner is never granted.
DP.studio.syncLimited: Limited — a tease, they cannot open it
DP.studio.textShownHint: Which of its texts lies on the map, below its picture and its name. Automatic prefers public text, then a biography or a description, and never a field named for the GM or as private.
DP.studio.title: Pin Studio
DP.studio.typeSizeHint: In scene pixels. Resize the pin to show more or less of the document; the text keeps this size.
DP.whatsnew.v0_2.fit: Text size and Margins in Pin Studio; Fit to content and Reset size in the Studio, the HUD and Alt+Shift+F. While placing, Shift+Alt+wheel sets the text size and F fits.
DP.whatsnew.v0_2.grab: Click a pin on the Notes layer to grab it — no more switching to the Tiles layer first.
DP.whatsnew.v0_2.menu: The Pinboard's … button is a real menu, rows can be reordered with Alt+arrows, and a filter lists the pins someone can see but not open.
DP.whatsnew.v0_2.reader: Opening a prop brings the view in when the text is too small to read; a click on the prop you are reading closes it.
DP.whatsnew.v0_2.resize: A prop is a window onto its document: resize it to show more or less of the page at the same text size. Text that does not fit fades out at the bottom.
DP.whatsnew.v0_3.ar: Three augmented-reality effects — Projected Readout, Tagged and Signal Loss — and the Preset Studio can now edit colours and shapes, not only numbers.
DP.whatsnew.v0_3.source: Pin Studio can change which document a pin shows, and which page of it. The pin keeps its size, its effect and its audience.
